lines.text: The Teacher saw wickedness in the place of judgment, and said God will judge the righteous and the wicked.
God tests men to show they are but beasts, since men and beasts share one fate and return to dust.
The Teacher saw nothing better for a man than to eat and drink, because that is his lot.
The Teacher saw the tears of the oppressed, who had no comforter, while the power lay with their oppressors.
He admired the living over the dead, but said better than both is he who has not yet existed.

wrong_details.wrong: admired the living over the dead
wrong_details.true: admired the dead above the living
